purpose: Replace page-box-only PDF imports with deterministic PDFs made from the checked cropped SVGs, preserving the visible vector crop while removing every extractable text character.

render_and_text_tools.source_crop_render_command_template: pdftoppm -f PAGE -l PAGE -r 576 -x X_PIXELS -y Y_PIXELS -W WIDTH_PIXELS -H HEIGHT_PIXELS -singlefile -png SOURCE.pdf OUTPUT_PREFIX

global_checks.page_box_interpretation: MuPDF writes an explicit MediaBox. Under PDF defaults the absent CropBox, TrimBox, BleedBox, and ArtBox take the same effective rectangle; both the direct keys and all five effective boxes are recorded for every figure.

visual_inspection.inspector_note: Inspected the 576 dpi source/old/replacement comparison, the SVG-authority comparison, and the full-resolution replacement. The three time labels, arrows, colored streamline curves, and all crop edges match with no clipping or visible distortion. Recorded differences are confined to subpixel edge antialiasing.

limitations: The raster comparison checks one Poppler rendering at 576 dpi; it is not an operator-by-operator equivalence proof for the two vector files.
Visible labels are vector outlines in the replacement PDFs, so text extractors intentionally return no characters from the figure assets.
The cropped SVG files retain full-page outline definitions and drawing commands outside the view box. The replacement PDF page clips that geometry; none of it remains extractable as text.
